lockup.summary: Directors, executive officers and certain shareholders agreed not to sell their shares for 180 days after the date of the prospectus, with limited exceptions. The lead underwriters can give written consent to sell sooner.

what: It develops antibody medicines that last longer in the body, for lung and skin diseases such as asthma and COPD.
proceeds: It expects about $203.8 million in net proceeds from the offering and a private sale to Sanofi. It will use this and its existing cash to run trials of its two drug candidates, WIN378 and WIN027, and to take early research programs into pre-trial studies. The rest is for general costs.
